questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer:
I love Paris, the architectures are very stylish and historical..
and when we walked into a bakery at the first day.. it's really interesting when staff heard we were talking to them in English rather than French.. HAHAHA, but I love croissant and Pain au chocolat, AMAZING

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
check the location of Airbnb/hotel is safe or not
learn how to greeting ppl in French also learn some basic words like thank u/good bye/excuse me/sorry
try local authentic croissant.
